name: Anti-Overfit Candidate Gate
description: Given ANY candidate list - from a sweep, a council, a marketplace, a reviewer - decide ADOPT / BUILD / PRUNE / DEFER against a fixed rejected-architecture list, a dedup set and an absorption budget, WITHOUT re-running discovery. Stages S0-S3 are deterministic set arithmetic; only the ambiguous residue reaches a model. The signature property is fail-closed on a blank required input: a missing or empty already-built inventory makes the gate REFUSE to run rather than pass everything, because a required-but-blank field defaults to worst case, not to 'probably fine'. Its tool policy denies every discovery tool: this blueprint may judge, never search.

candidates.description: The candidate list under judgement; this gate never produces one

already_built_inventory.description: Required. An absent or EMPTY inventory makes the gate refuse: passing every candidate because the dedup set is missing is the fail-open this exists to prevent.

rejected_components.description: Rejected ARCHITECTURES (a second orchestration runtime, a vector-DB memory, a durable-execution engine, a trained critic, observability SaaS, a guardrail framework) - not unfamiliar ideas

absorption_budget.description: A HARD cap on ADOPT+BUILD verdicts, not a suggestion

owner_override_register.description: Optional S1b: where a knowingly-accepted anchor violation is recorded

gate-runner.description: Runs the deterministic set arithmetic; has judge authority precisely because it exercises no judgement

adjudicator.description: Sees ONLY the ambiguous residue the deterministic stages could not decide, and must give a reason code per ruling

routes.reason: only the ambiguous residue is worth a model; the rest is set arithmetic

inputs-complete.expression: already_built_inventory_rows > 0 AND rejected_components_declared > 0 AND absorption_budget_declared == true AND candidate_rows > 0

stages.title: FAIL CLOSED: refuse to run on a blank required input
S0 deterministic dedup against the already-built set

work_unit.title: Mark every candidate that already exists, by exact and normalised name match
work_unit.question_or_target: Compare each candidate against the already-built inventory by exact match and by a normalised form (case, separators, common suffixes). A match is PRUNE with reason code DUPLICATE-OF-BUILT naming the matched row.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: set membership is exactly computable; an LLM comparison here measured 86 percent accurate with 100 percent of errors in the unsafe direction

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every PRUNE names the inventory row it matched and the match kind (exact / normalised); the comparison is a script, not a judgement
tests_required: MANDATORY: a candidate identical to a built item must be PRUNED with the matched row named
both-states: a genuinely new candidate in the same list must survive - a deduper that prunes everything is as broken as one that prunes nothing
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the anchor stage re-reads the survivors only; a pruned candidate is not re-litigated by a model
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0201 emitted only when every candidate has a dedup outcome and every PRUNE names its matched row and match kind; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0201 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a deterministic comparison over unchanged inputs cannot produce a different result

stages.title: S1 anti-overfit anchor: reject a rejected ARCHITECTURE, not an unfamiliar idea

work_unit.title: Prune any survivor that reintroduces a declared rejected architecture
work_unit.question_or_target: Check each surviving candidate against the rejected_components list. A match is PRUNE with reason code ANCHOR-VIOLATION naming the component. Unfamiliarity is NOT a reason: the list is of rejected architectures, not of ideas the estate has not seen before.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a declared list plus text matching; judgement enters only at the residue stage

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every ANCHOR-VIOLATION names the rejected component matched and quotes the candidate text that matched it
tests_required: MANDATORY: a candidate proposing a vector-DB memory must be PRUNED with the anchor named
a merely UNFAMILIAR candidate must NOT be pruned by this stage - that would make the anchor a novelty filter
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner override register is the only route to accept a known anchor violation, and it records who accepted it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0202 emitted only when every survivor has an anchor outcome and every violation names its component plus the matching text; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0202 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: deterministic matching over unchanged inputs

stages.title: S2 bus check: does it ride the existing hook / skill / MCP bus, or demand a new runtime?

work_unit.title: Classify each survivor by the bus it needs and downgrade a bus-less ADOPT to DEFER
work_unit.question_or_target: For each survivor decide which existing bus carries it - hook, skill, MCP, CLI, or NONE. A candidate that needs a bus the estate does not have is downgraded to DEFER with the missing bus NAMED, never adopted on the assumption the bus will appear.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: bus presence is a filesystem and config fact, not an opinion

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row names the carrying bus and the file or config that proves the bus exists; a DEFER names the missing bus
tests_required: a candidate needing a bus the estate lacks must be DEFER with that bus named, not ADOPT
both-states: a candidate riding an existing MCP must be allowed through with the proving locator recorded
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the budget stage cannot promote a DEFER back to ADOPT; only the owner override register can
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0203 emitted only when every survivor names its bus, with a locator when the bus exists and a name when it does not; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0203 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: deterministic inspection over unchanged inputs

stages.title: S3 absorption budget: a hard cap, not a suggestion

work_unit.title: Fit the survivors into the absorption budget and DEFER the overflow explicitly
work_unit.question_or_target: Rank the survivors and admit at most absorption_budget of them as ADOPT or BUILD. Everything above the line becomes DEFER with reason code BUDGET-OVERFLOW and its rank recorded, so nothing is silently dropped.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: counting and ranking are exactly computable

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the artifact states the budget, the admitted count and the overflow count numerically, and every overflow row carries its rank
tests_required: with budget 0 every survivor must be DEFER with BUDGET-OVERFLOW - a budget of zero must be honoured, not treated as unset
the admitted count must never exceed the budget
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the budget gate recomputes the admitted count independently of this stage's own claim
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0204 emitted only when admitted count is at most the budget, and every overflow row carries a rank and the BUDGET-OVERFLOW reason code; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0204 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: deterministic arithmetic over unchanged inputs

stages.title: The ONLY model-judged stage: the ambiguous residue

work_unit.title: Rule on the candidates the deterministic stages could not decide
work_unit.question_or_target: For each candidate the deterministic stages left ambiguous - a near-match that may be a genuinely new variant, a bus that half exists - rule ADOPT / BUILD / PRUNE / DEFER with a reason code, and say which deterministic stage was ambiguous and why.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each ruling names the ambiguous stage, the competing readings, and the reason code chosen
tests_required: a semantic near-match that is a genuinely new variant must be allowed through with the difference stated - a deduper that prunes every variant ossifies the estate
the adjudicator must not touch a candidate the deterministic stages already decided
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer checks no deterministic verdict was overturned here
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0205 emitted only when every ambiguous candidate has a ruling with a reason code, and no unambiguous candidate was re-decided; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0205 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: Every verdict has a reason code and the budget was not exceeded

work_unit.title: Reduce every stage outcome to one verdict per candidate with its reason code
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce one row per input candidate: verdict, reason code, the stage that decided it, and the anchor or inventory row it matched where relevant. The row count must equal the input candidate count exactly.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a deterministic reduction over the stage outcomes

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the artifact reconciles its row count against the input candidate count and states the per-verdict tallies numerically
tests_required: the verdict row count must equal the input candidate count - a dropped candidate is a defect, not a filter
every row must carry a reason code; a verdict without one is invalid
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the calling workflow reads this table; a row count mismatch is a hard reject
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0206 emitted only when one verdict per input candidate, each with a reason code, reconciled against the input count; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0206 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: deterministic reduction over unchanged inputs

impact.blast_radius: judgement only: no discovery tool is reachable and no write leaves command-center/decisions/bp-gem-02/**

derived_from.credit: owner (the anchor stage existed only inside that run)

contraindications: NOT a discovery stage - it never searches, and its tool policy denies every search tool
NOT for candidates whose value is unknown - send those to a probe first
do NOT use it to reject a candidate merely because it is unfamiliar: the list is of rejected ARCHITECTURES
x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate_of_bp_gem_01: BP-GEM-01 discovers; this only judges - and can judge lists it did not produce (a council's options, a marketplace listing, a reviewer's suggestions). It is called BY BP-GEM-01 as a subworkflow, which is why neither reimplements the other.
unverified: UNVERIFIED whether standalone use changes any verdict; settling experiment = apply it to the last three candidate lists produced in this estate and count changed verdicts.
x_extensions.owner_decision: What is the absorption budget per cycle, and who curates rejected_components so the anchor does not ossify?

worked_example.name: judge a 40-candidate sweep output against a budget of 6
acceptance: a candidate identical to a built item is PRUNED by S0 with the matched row named
a candidate proposing a vector store is PRUNED by S1 with the anchor named
an EMPTY already_built_inventory makes the gate REFUSE, not pass everything

stopping_rule_controls.why: the floor stops an empty candidate list from reading as a completed judgement
THE signature property: a blank required input must escalate, never pass everything
